patterns.note: Full-bleed hero image with centered text overlay, establishing a luxurious and aspirational tone immediately.
Horizontal scrolling navigation for service categories within a section, allowing users to explore options without leaving the current view.
Asymmetrical two-column layouts for service descriptions, pairing a large aspirational image with concise text and a call-to-action.
Prominent, elegant serif headings for major sections are contrasted with a clean sans-serif for body text and navigation, creating a sophisticated hierarchy.
High contrast between dark text and light backgrounds, with the hero image providing the primary visual accent and warmth.
Large, centered, uppercase section titles act as clear and elegant dividers between distinct content blocks.

The provided scroll sequence images do not show the main page content scrolling, making it impossible to infer scroll-triggered motion. Based on the single full-page screenshot, the page appears to rely on static content presentation.

technique_notes: A full-bleed hero image is used with a subtle, semi-transparent dark overlay to ensure text readability, featuring a large, elegant heading and a subtle call to action button.
Service categories are presented in a horizontally scrollable list, allowing users to browse different treatment options without navigating away from the current section.
Content sections alternate between full-width and two-column layouts, often pairing aspirational imagery with descriptive text and a call-to-action button to guide user engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels for navigation and calls to action.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and ample whitespace around text blocks, creating a luxurious and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of high-end editorial photography with a clean, minimal layout creates a luxurious and trustworthy impression for aesthetic medicine, successfully avoiding common clinical aesthetics. The elegant serif typography paired with aspirational imagery sets a sophisticated and aspirational tone.
